title: Would you trust AI to build investment theses?
author: Unlucky_Employee4923
selftext:
I've been thinking about this recently.

There's a growing number of AI tools that don't just summarize market news, they try to connect economic events, policy changes, and market reactions into a complete investment thesis. It sounds useful in theory, but I still think human judgment plays an important role when interpreting the bigger picture.

Could AI become a reliable research assistant, or is building an investment thesis something that still needs a human touch?

What do you think?
